# Candidate verification, careful interpretation and Change Log

## Stage 1 questions

Ask **exactly 3–5** personalised questions ONLY after a sourced provisional audit.
Choose the facts most likely to change a source-linked R-ID classification,
role/programme viability or top development priorities.

Every question should test **one coherent uncertainty**. The question can ask
about role, timing, personal involvement and output within the same activity;
it must not bundle independent competencies merely to ask fewer questions.
List linked R-ID(s) only when the same response fact truly affects them.

Be explicit about what a short `yes` or `no` would mean, and allow `unsure` and
`prefer not to answer`. Do not treat refusal, no activity, or an unknown answer
as proof of lack of underlying competency. Do not interrogate every UNKNOWN.

Finish Stage 1 by inviting actual answers and **STOP**. Do not generate final
course recommendations or a detailed roadmap prematurely.

## Stage 2 interpreting answers

Each fresh participant answer is `SELF-REPORTED` unless independently corroborated.
A bare 'yes' establishes only the proposition asked — it does not provide dates,
responsibility, specific tools or completed outputs unless stated. A bare 'no' to
'I have implemented X' establishes no reported implementation, NOT inability to
learn or perform X. When a composite question was asked ambiguously, keep its
independent parts unresolved; do not spread a single answer across R-IDs.

If a reply contradicts a dated CV statement, request one focused clarification
if essential to the decision or retain both, without automatic privilege to the
newer or older statement.

## Change Log requirements

For **every R-ID addressed by user replies**, include a row *even when its
classification did not change*:

| R-ID | Old label | New label | New evidence | Provenance | Explanation of change or retention; remaining uncertainty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Change labels **only** when supplied evidence meets the classification rule;
do not mechanically preserve or automatically upgrade. Record useful new data
on unchanged-label rows. Say `No classification changes` where applicable.
Unaddressed R-IDs keep their labels, source link and provenance unchanged.

After the Change Log, give a **revised summary of every original R-ID**, with
classification rationale and remaining uncertainty. Never silently substitute a
new scope, drop an old row or renumber IDs. An explicit refusal to answer yields
an explicitly **PROVISIONAL** plan retaining unresolved statuses. With partial
answers, update only supported items.
